newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia stocks climb, Uhispank active.
newsitem.headline: Estonia stocks climb, Uhispank active.

text.p: Shares on the Tallinn bourse gained slightly on Wednesday and dealers said there was growing pressure to take the market higher next week.
"Some buying interest was seen and larger amounts were asked for," one analyst said.
"Many investors think that the bottom was reached and it is time to increase positions," he added.
But he said that players on the sell-side were not ready to offload stocks as they thought prices were still low.
"The pressure moved from the selling side slightly to the buy side," he added.
Uhispank was the most active with trade of 19.5 million kroons of shares on a gain of 0.40 kroons to 57.35.
Dealers said the share was boosted by a decision to declare a new share issue.
Hansapank closed 4.00 kroons higher at 269.50 kroons on trade of 11.6 million kroons of shares.
On the free market, diversified manufacturer Norma was most traded on turnover of 8.2 million kroons. The share price gained 0.25 kroons to close on 75 kroons.
